visibleTestCases.title: Drain Unknown Messages (Mailbox Length = 0)
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, P} = incident_mailbox_leak:start(), [P ! {legacy_heartbeat, os:system_time()} || _ <- lists:seq(1, 50)], ok = incident_mailbox_leak:record_metric(P, 10), ok = incident_mailbox_leak:record_metric(P, 20), [P ! {legacy_heartbeat, os:system_time()} || _ <- lists:seq(1, 50)], timer:sleep(30), Len = incident_mailbox_leak:inspect_queue_len(P), {ok, Summary} = incident_mailbox_leak:get_summary(P), incident_mailbox_leak:stop(P), {Len, Summary} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Blasts 100 legacy heartbeat messages mixed with metrics; verifies mailbox length is 0 and summary stats are exact.

visibleTestCases.title: Client Call Timeout Fallback
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin DeadPid = spawn(fun() -> ok end), timer:sleep(10), incident_mailbox_leak:get_summary(DeadPid) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Calls get_summary/1 against a dead process; confirms caller returns {error, timeout} within 1,000ms instead of hanging forever.
